title: Casebook — Time Already Waited and the Replacement Deposit Percentage (Pre-Orders & Back-Orders)
content:
**Governing rule.** The customer has already waited on the Pre-Orders & Back-Orders Deposit Pre-Order being replaced. The replacement deposit percentage is therefore multiplied according to how long that reservation was held, from its reservation date to its cancellation:

- by **0.8** when it was held 60 days or more;
- by **0.9** when it was held 30 days up to fewer than 60 days;
- by **1.0**, leaving the percentage as it is, when it was held for less.

Days are calendar days from the reservation date to the cancellation date on the record of the reservation replaced.

**Cases (hypothetical; replacement deposit percentage of 20 before this rule)**

| Case | Reserved | Cancelled | Days held | Multiplier | Percentage after |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | 1 March | 30 April | 60 | 0.8 | 16 |
| B | 1 March | 29 April | 59 | 0.9 | 18 |
| C | 1 March | 31 March | 30 | 0.9 | 18 |
| D | 1 March | 30 March | 29 | 1.0 | 20 |

**Reading the cases.** Case A sits exactly on 60 days and takes 0.8. Case C sits exactly on 30 days and takes 0.9. The count stops at the cancellation date of the reservation replaced. It does not run to the day the replacement is taken.
